svg.text: Personal Library — Backend RAG Sequence (Ollama + Qdrant)
Ingestion and query, both strictly sequential inside a single HTTP request — no concurrency anywhere in this path
UML Sequence
INGESTION — DocumentService.uploadDocument() · four Ollama round trips, one after another
QUERY — VectorRagService.chatWithDocument() · retrieve first, then generate

g.text: 5. extractMetadata(fileName, text) — skipped if user sent BibTeX
10. vectorStore.add() embeds every chunk · OLLAMA 2 of 4
22. ranked chunks — chunkIndex arrives as Long
23. join passages into grounded system prompt

svg.text: FALLBACK PATHS — all three fail soft
1. Qdrant indexing throws → logged as a warning only.
The upload still returns 200 with nothing indexed.
2. Similarity search fails or returns nothing →
falls back to docEntity.contentExcerpt as context.
3. Chat model unavailable → a fixed apology string,
so the request never surfaces a 5xx to the browser.
TIMEOUT BUDGET — the sum, not one call
OLLAMA_READ_TIMEOUT · 10 min — applied PER CALL
nginx proxy_read_timeout · 2160s (36 min)
LLM_TIMEOUT_MS (browser fetch) · 35 min
Upload chains up to FOUR Ollama calls, so the
worst case approaches — and can exceed — the
35/36 min client and proxy budgets downstream.
CONFIGURED VALUES (read from source)
Chunking · paragraph split, ~400 chars, 50-char floor
Embeddings · nomic-embed-text, 768 dims, 8k context
Retrieval · topK 4, similarityThreshold 0.5
Models · app.models.llama=llama3.2 · mistral=mistral
Summaries · first 6,000 chars of the extracted text
Point IDs are UUIDv3 — Qdrant rejects suffixed GUIDs.
